usage: The word 黃色 (wong4 sik1) is used as a noun to refer to the color yellow.
You can use 黃色 to describe objects, clothes, and anything that is literally yellow in color.
In Cantonese, 黃色 can function like an adjective when placed before a noun, e.g., 黃色衫 means yellow shirt.
It is common to combine 黃色 with other nouns to specify the color of an item, especially in shopping or clothing contexts.
When describing colors, 黃色 usually stays the same regardless of singular or plural objects.
